items.title_zh: 锈斑猫鲜为人知的生活，体重仅三磅的难以捉摸的掠食者

items.summary_zh: David V. Raju/Wikimedia Commons 锈斑猫是世界上最小的猫科动物，身体只有 13 到 19 英寸长。在印度、斯里兰卡和尼泊尔的荒野中，潜伏着一种凶猛的掠食者，它在该地区的丛林和草原上悄悄地跟踪猎物——但它的重量只有三磅。锈斑猫可能是世界上最小的野生猫科动物，但它生来就是为了杀人。
items.summary_en: David V. Raju/Wikimedia Commons The rusty-spotted cat is the smallest feline in the world, with a body that’s just 13 to 19 inches long. In the wilderness of India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal lurks a fierce predator, quietly stalking its prey through the region’s jungles and grasslands — but it only weighs three pounds. The rusty-spotted cat may be the smallest wild feline in the world, but it’s built to kill.

items.title_zh: 地铁与 AQI 30：居住在德里和班加罗尔的夫妇比较城市
items.title_en: Metro vs AQI 30: Couple who lived in Delhi and Bengaluru compare cities
items.summary_zh: 万查和萨克沙姆没有选择一个城市而不是另一个城市，而是谈到了他们在每个城市所欣赏的经历。
items.summary_en: Rather than choosing one city over the other, Vancha and Saksham spoke about the experiences they have come to appreciate in each.

items.title_en: ‘Better off in India’: Man says high expenses in Dubai make it hard to save
items.summary_zh: 在一天前分享的 Instagram 视频中，拉胡尔·巴拉 (Rahul Bala) 谈到了在迪拜生活的挑战，并警告人们在搬到迪拜工作之前要“三思而后行”。
items.summary_en: In an Instagram video shared a day ago, Rahul Bala spoke about the challenges of living in Dubai and warned people to ‘think twice’ before moving there for work.

items.title_en: Is That An iPhone? 1937 Painting Leaves Internet Puzzled Over Man’s Mysterious Object
items.summary_zh: 一幅 1937 年的画作在网上引发了一场奇怪的争论，因为观众发现一名男子拿着一个长方形的小物体，看起来惊人地像一部现代智能手机。
items.summary_en: A 1937 painting has sparked a strange online debate after viewers spotted a man holding a small rectangular object that looks surprisingly like a modern smartphone.
